create_ManifoldGaussian: create a ManifoldGaussian with a sequence of Manifold means and an optional precision matrix
update_ManifoldGaussian: update the mean and precision of a ManifoldGaussian with validated new values
copy_ManifoldGaussian: copy a ManifoldGaussian object to create a deep copy with a new name
run_local_gaussian: run local_gaussian to project a ManifoldGaussian into the tangent plane at a LieGroup variable
run_retract_gaussian: run retract_gaussian to compute a ManifoldGaussian from tangent plane mean and precision
